report_name: 3.8 Million Individuals Impacted by Unlimited Technology Systems Data Breach

identities.name: Unlimited Technology Systems
identities.description: An Ohio-based provider of financial technology to the healthcare sector that suffered a data breach affecting 3,803,750 individuals. The breach occurred in October 2025 and involved unauthorized access to a data center and exfiltration of PII and PHI.

identities.name: Oncology and specialty healthcare providers
identities.description: Over 11,000 healthcare providers who use Unlimited Technology Systems' technology. Their patients' data was compromised in the breach.

indicators.name: Suspicious Encoded PowerShell Command
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Encoded PowerShell Command
id: 2b8c1f9a-5e3d-4f8b-9c1a-7d4e2f8b1c9a
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of encoded PowerShell commands, a common technique for obfuscating malicious activity.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/3-8-million-impacted-by-unlimited-technology-systems-data-breach/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-07
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.execution
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' -enc '
      - ' -EncodedCommand '
  condition: selection
indicators.description: A hunting hint from the article suggests looking for encoded PowerShell commands, which are often used to hide malicious scripts from detection.

indicators.name: Suspicious Archive File Creation on Server
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Archive File Creation on Server
id: 8d1e2f3a-4b5c-4d6e-8f9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of compressed archive files (.zip, .rar, .7z) on servers, which can be indicative of data staging before exfiltration.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/3-8-million-impacted-by-unlimited-technology-systems-data-breach/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-07
tags:
  - attack.t1560.001
  - attack.collection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative activity involving archiving.
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.zip'
      - '.rar'
      - '.7z'
  filter_legit_paths:
    Image|endswith:
      - 'explorer.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit_paths
indicators.description: A hunting hint from the article suggests looking for the creation of large archive files, which often precedes data exfiltration.

indicators.name: Rclone Command-Line Execution for Data Transfer
indicators.pattern:
title: Rclone Command-Line Execution for Data Transfer
id: 5c6d7e8f-9a0b-4c2d-8e4f-5a6b7c8d9e0f
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of rclone, a tool often abused by threat actors for data exfiltration to cloud storage services.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/3-8-million-impacted-by-unlimited-technology-systems-data-breach/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-07
tags:
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.exfiltration
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\rclone.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'copy'
      - 'sync'
      - 'move'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: A hunting hint from the article suggests looking for the use of the rclone tool, which is commonly used for data exfiltration.
